normalization_plan.reason: Parameter 'to' has no independent semantics and is fully absorbed by the transfer function node.
Parameter 'tokens' is only meaningful inside transfer and merges into its core function node.
Parameter 'from' only exists to select the debited balance inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'to' is only used to credit balances inside transferFrom.
Parameter 'tokens' is the transfer amount consumed solely by transferFrom.
Parameter 'spender' is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter 'tokens' only sets the allowance value inside approve.
Parameter 'spender' is both allowance key and callback target used only by approveAndCall.
Parameter 'tokens' only sets the allowance value forwarded by approveAndCall.
Parameter 'data' is only forwarded into the external callback invoked by approveAndCall.
Parameter 'tokenAddress' is only the external callee address selected by the rescue function.
Parameter 'tokens' is only the amount passed to the external transfer call.
Parameter '_newOwner' only becomes the pending owner inside transferOwnership.
Local result variable c exists only to hold and return the addition result of safeAdd.
